title: Pako — Walkies
summary: Extra-combat Pako voltron that exiles every library, then Haldan casts the fetch-countered pile.

tags.name: voltron
tags.reason: Pako is the attacker: extra combats, auras, equipment, and protection all sit on that body.

tags.name: extra combats
tags.reason: Five extra-combat cards plus Moraug landfall exist to repeat Pako's attack trigger.

tags.name: theft
tags.reason: Haldan spends opponents' exiled noncreature spells and lands as the main midgame resource.

tags.name: exile
tags.reason: Pako stocks exile every attack; Archaeologist, Doc Aurlock, Lost and the Damned, and Fireball pay off casts from exile.

tags.name: commander matters
tags.reason: Guild Artisan, Passionate Archaeologist, Leyline Immersion, free commander spells, and Overpowering Attack freerunning all key off the commanders.

tags.name: equipment
tags.reason: Sword, Cleaver, Shadowspear, and both boots are the combat-mana and protection package.

tags.name: auras
tags.reason: Bear Umbra, Canopy Cover, Mark of Sakiko, Leyline Immersion, and the Forest auras are dedicated enchantments on Pako or lands.

tags.name: clones
tags.reason: Irenicus and Quantum Misalignment make nonlegendary extra Pakos; Helm sits on the maybeboard.

tags.name: treasure
tags.reason: Guild Artisan and The Reaver Cleaver make Treasures as combat mana, not a Treasure deck.

tags.name: landfall
tags.reason: Moraug is the landfall extra-combat payoff; Exploration and Summer Bloom feed him.

tags.name: spellslinger
tags.reason: A large instant and sorcery suite supports combat rather than a storm or prowess plan.
